(507)sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/gsang ba sngags kyi srung ma mchogabarten nas phris las sgrub pa'i phyir/las kyi rim pa'i byang bu spel/de yang lcags sam

tei:div.tei:p: sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ gsang ba sngags kyi srung ma mchog brten nas phris las sgrub pa'i phyir/ las kyi rim pa'i byang bu spel/ de yang lcags sam bhandha'i snod du dmar gtor zur gsum pa mthob kyu dang sha sna khyad par ra mtshan gyis brgyan pa byin gyis brlabs te/ hūm̐ bhyo/ las kyi mkha' 'gro mi srun ma/ stag srin dkar ser zer ba'i gdongs/ sha za mkha' 'gro dam tshan tshogs/ shar phyogs nam mkha'i dkyil yang nas/ sde brgyad tshogs pa'i pho brang nas/ mchod cing brten zhing sgrub pa'i phyir/ skad cig yud la gshegs su gsol/ 'bru bzang sna tshogs bshos bu brtsigs/ dar zab mang po rgyan du btags/ 'bru bcud mngar gyi skyes su 'bul/ rta nor rnga mong bya yi tshogs (508)gser dngul rin chen tshogs mang po/ gsol cig rol cig dgyes par mdzod/ sman gtor rakta bha lingta/ chu sna stong dang me tog stong*/ ra mchin logs sha khrag tshogs/ dkar gsum mngar gsum sman gyi rigs/ mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ bdag cag sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ 'byor ldan nor dang brjid chacen gos/ bcud ldan zas gyi dngos grub stsol/ rigs brgyud dpal gyi dngos grub stsol/ lha cig go 'jo'i spyan snga ru/ ji ltar khas blang dam bcas bzhin/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyen po srung*/ rnor sgrub pa'i sdong grogs kyis/ rang las 'phags pa'i snyan grags kyis/ rgyal khams ma lus dbang bsdas te/ zas nor longs spyod dbang thang spel/ (509)(51)mdor na legs pa'i yon tan tshogs/ gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ ces pa gter srung zer gdong gi phrin las 'di padma las 'brel gyis so/// /
